name: linkedin-post
notes:
Modelled on linkedin.com as of 2026-09; not run against live LinkedIn. /feed/?shareActive=true opens the share box (the 'Start a post' modal) on load. signedIn: the global nav's Me photo (img.global-nav__me-photo), rendered only when logged in. Post text: the share box's Quill editor (.ql-editor contenteditable inside [role=dialog]; one

per line). submit: the share box's Post button (button.share-actions__primary-action). receipt: the 'Post successful.' toast (.artdeco-toast-item) and its View post link (a.artdeco-toast-item__cta) to /feed/update/urn:li:activity:/, with LinkedIn's trailing slash.
